title: Levothyroxine for Children With Euthyroid Sick Syndrome
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to determine whether levothyroxine is effective and safe in the treatment of children with euthyroid sick syndrome, hospitalized in a pediatric intensive care unit.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* All children aged 1 month to 17 years.
* Admitted to pediatric intensive care unit.
* TSH and thyroid hormones below age specific levels.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Known thyroid condition.
* Brain death.
* Gut conditions that contraindicate oral route.
* Readmissions to intensive care unit.
